abi.mutationAuthority: None; stateless read-only native source validation and model/source-location parsing

api.sourceLocations: Exact objects array with stable canonical UUID, /objects/i pointer and whole-object UTF16 sourceRange including BOM/CRLF/nonBMP offsets
api.immutability: Pure return values deep-frozen and detached; raw author degrees, color spelling and numeric values retained
api.coordinates: Right-handed, Y-up, -Z camera forward; EulerXYZ column-vector transform T*Rx*Ry*Rz*S
api.missingCapability: studio_core_unavailable only for the independent 3D interface

portableSource.prepared: Separate actual prepared desktop/mobile VM proof pending parent final prepare; no device acceptance

retainedAttempts.reason: New capability-isolation fixture called nonexistent supportsStudioCoreComposition instead of existing supportsStudioCoreCompositionPatch. Only the new test fixture was corrected; production unchanged.

boundaries: Strict exact single-file JSON with decoded duplicate-key rejection, safe Unicode, finite values and 128KiB UTF8 bound
1–128 unique canonical lower-case UUID box objects, no assets/objectId/World/behavior/hierarchy/scene composition admission
GPU-practical nonvertical camera/light constraints, bounded FOV/frustum/coordinates/positive size, source values retained
Native CST validates source and produces whole-object byte ranges converted to UTF16; bridge validates complete model and each source-bound location
Independent optional ABI, no fallback to 2D and no native geometry history or existing author operation changes
Renderer and standalone Godot prototype export are separate adapters; this report does not claim device acceptance, pixel parity, installed IDE or integration with the 2D build service
